skills.name: event-staffing-ordering
skills.description: Use when a user needs to hire event staff, book brand ambassadors, get an event staffing quote, or budget W-2 event workers in the US or Canada — trade shows, conferences, festivals, concerts, stadium events, corporate events, brand activations. Gathers requirements, checks live city coverage, W-2 rate ranges, lead-time guidance, and state compliance via MCP, then produces a structured staffing request. Do not use for permanent hiring, non-event temp work, markets outside US/Canada, or 1099 gig-worker sourcing.

skills.name: event-staffing-compliance
skills.description: Use when a user asks about W-2 vs 1099 event workers, worker misclassification risk, joint-employer liability, certificates of insurance (COI), or wage/hour compliance for event staff in the US or Canada. Looks up state-specific minimum wage, overtime rules, and classification quirks live via MCP. Do not use for non-event staffing, permanent employment questions, or markets outside US/Canada.
